name: SteamOS
description: Valve's gaming-focused Linux operating system, built around the Steam gaming experience.
fullDescription: SteamOS is Valve's Linux-based operating system for the Steam Deck and compatible hardware. The official Steam Deck image is available from Valve and is designed around a console-like Steam interface.
cons: Official image is primarily aimed at Steam Deck hardware
guide: Use Valve's official SteamOS download page and recovery image documentation. Back up your data before reimaging a drive.

name: Bazzite
description: Gaming-focused Fedora Atomic OS for desktops, handhelds and living-room PCs.
fullDescription: Bazzite is designed for gaming and everyday use, with Steam, Lutris, gaming optimizations, HDR/VRR support and optional Steam Gaming Mode images for handhelds and HTPCs.
guide: Choose the image for your GPU, desktop and Steam Gaming Mode preference on the official download page.

name: Nobara Linux
description: Fedora-based desktop Linux with gaming, multimedia and driver improvements ready to use.
fullDescription: Nobara focuses on making Fedora easier for desktop gaming and creative workloads. Its official downloads include desktop and Steam-focused HTPC and handheld variants, with separate NVIDIA images.
cons: Read project guidance before dual booting
guide: Pick the ISO matching your GPU and form factor. Check the official Nobara download page and guide before installation.

name: ChimeraOS
description: Console-style Linux gaming OS designed to turn a PC into a living-room gaming machine.
fullDescription: ChimeraOS provides a controller-friendly Steam-based couch gaming experience with automatic updates and support for multiple game stores and emulation through its ecosystem.
cons: Dual booting from the same disk is not supported
guide: Download the installer from the official ChimeraOS download page and follow its hardware requirements before installing.

name: Playtron GameOS
description: Linux gaming OS built around a console-style experience and multiple game stores.
fullDescription: Playtron GameOS is a Linux-based gaming operating system designed for PCs and handhelds, with integrations for Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG and other gaming providers.
cons: Windows games rely on compatibility technology
guide: Download the current GameOS installer from Playtron and flash it to an external drive before booting your target hardware.

name: CachyOS
description: Performance-focused Arch Linux distribution with dedicated gaming packages and a handheld edition.
fullDescription: CachyOS is an optimized Arch-based desktop distribution. Its gaming tooling includes Steam, Heroic, Lutris, Gamescope and MangoHud, while its Handheld Edition targets devices such as Steam Deck and ROG Ally.
guide: Choose Desktop or Handheld Edition from the official download page. Verify the ISO checksum before installing.

name: Garuda Linux
description: Arch-based desktop distribution popular for gaming, performance tuning and visual customization.
fullDescription: Garuda Linux is an Arch-based distribution with gaming-oriented editions and tools. Its Dr460nized edition is particularly popular among gamers who want a highly customized desktop.
guide: Use the official Garuda website to choose a gaming-oriented edition and installation method.

name: PikaOS
description: Gaming-focused Linux distribution aimed at easy setup, performance and modern gaming hardware.
fullDescription: PikaOS is a Linux gaming distribution focused on making gaming setup easier while providing performance-oriented packages and drivers.
guide: Use the project's current download page and documentation to select the latest desktop image.

name: Regata OS
description: Desktop Linux with a strong focus on gaming, hybrid graphics and easy access to Windows game launchers.
fullDescription: Regata OS is a Linux desktop distribution that focuses heavily on gaming. It includes GameMode, AMD FSR support and Regata OS Game Access for games from services beyond Steam.
guide: Download the latest PC image from the official Regata OS page or its linked SourceForge files.

name: Batocera Linux
description: Free retro-gaming Linux distribution for PCs, Steam Deck, Raspberry Pi and many handheld devices.
fullDescription: Batocera Linux turns PCs, single-board computers and supported handhelds into emulation-focused gaming systems with a controller-friendly interface and many emulator cores.
guide: Choose your hardware on the official download page, flash the image to the appropriate USB/SD media and add your legally owned games.

name: Recalbox
description: All-in-one retro gaming platform supporting PCs, Raspberry Pi, handhelds and other boards.
fullDescription: Recalbox is a Linux-based retro-gaming system with a console-style interface and support for a large range of classic platforms and hardware.
guide: Open the official download page, select your hardware and follow the flashing instructions.

name: Lakka
description: Lightweight Linux distribution built around RetroArch for turning hardware into a retro gaming console.
fullDescription: Lakka is a lightweight Linux distribution that transforms a small computer into a full-featured retro gaming console using RetroArch and Libretro cores.
guide: Choose your board or PC architecture on the official Lakka download page and flash the matching image.

name: winesapOS
description: Portable Linux gaming OS designed to run from external storage and work across compatible PCs and handhelds.
fullDescription: winesapOS is a portable Linux gaming environment that can be installed to external storage, making it useful for carrying a gaming setup between compatible machines.
guide: Check the project's current installation and image documentation before flashing an external drive.
